title: plugin-calendar: quick-create from an empty day is a dead end on an object with a required lookup — the dialog offers only Title, auto-fills required select/boolean/number fields but no lookup, and the create answers 400 "Project is required"
body:
Filing-gate category ① (product defect, named landing point) and ③ — the maintainer's order in the dispatching session, verbatim: 「测试遇到的问题，可以提交issue」.

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104 · records-forms.calendar-interactions · A3

**Reader who acts:** the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat (`plugin-calendar`). **Dedupe:** semantic issue search on this repo, closed included, "calendar quick create required lookup field Project is required dead end dialog" — 2 hits, neither this shape (objectui#11786, objectui#2793, both closed).

## Environment

objectstack `36b2889c` with the console built from objectui `1fb1ced36243` (the pin hop of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104, since landed as `f451a5964`), stock `examples/app-showcase`, `--seed-admin`, admin persona. Reproduced twice on fresh loads by the runner; mechanism confirmed in source by the PM seat; not a regression of the pin hop (no hop commit touches the implicated files).

## Reproduction

1. Open `/_console/apps/showcase_app/showcase_task/view/calendar`.
2. Click inside an empty day cell (role `gridcell`, aria-label "Tuesday, October 20, 2026"): the dialog "New event · On October 20, 2026" opens with a Title input only.
3. Type a title, click Create → `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_task` body `{"title":"…","due_date":"2026-10-20","status":"backlog"}` → **400** `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `fields: [{field: project, code: required}]`; the dialog shows "Project is required" and still offers no Project input.

**Expected:** a row created with `due_date` = the clicked day — either the dialog collects the required lookup or the quick-create hands off to the full form. **Actual:** no row can be created from the calendar on the stock task object (the date pre-fill itself is correct).

## Mechanism (objectui `1fb1ced36243`)

`packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx` `submitQuickCreate` auto-fills required fields of type select/picklist/status, boolean/checkbox and number-family only; a required lookup is left for the server to refuse, so the dialog has no path forward for `showcase_task.project`.
